key_impacts: 33 people killed in Dakshin Bedkashi Union.
3,520 houses washed away in Dakshin Bedkashi.
1,800 houses partially damaged in Dakshin Bedkashi.
Coastal embankment breached in six places; 20.55 km damaged.
Almost the entire union inundated; villages flooded twice daily until 2013.
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65-knot winds and a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila and the storm surge killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, and partially damaged 1,800.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment (six places), damaging 20.55 km; villages inundated twice daily until repairs in 2013.
